competency_fulfillment.rationale: Two of the sampled money number-line items are internally inconsistent. 'The dot is at ₱10 and it moves forward ₱1.' is keyed to the second option in a list reading 70 / 71 / 76 / 66, a set which does not contain eleven at all; another item starting at five pesos and moving forward ten pesos is keyed to eighty-five. The stem asks for one amount and the key answers a different one, with no correct choice available.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: The competency covers bills and-slash-or coins, but the sampled totals are either all coins or all bills; no item totals a mixed handful of bills together with coins, which is the case the and-or phrasing exists to capture.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: The composing tasks defeat themselves: 'Use coins and bills to make exactly ₱60. Use the fewest pieces possible.' is keyed to sixty, the number already printed in the stem, so nothing about choosing pieces or minimising their number is actually required or recorded.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Once the broken number-line items and the self-answering composing items are set aside, what remains is a small set of straightforward totalling questions, so the apparent breadth of presentation is not doing real work.

competency_alignment.rationale: Determining the value of a group of pieces is the target skill, but a large share of seeds instead exercise movement along a marked line, an axis that belongs to counting on rather than to valuing a collection of money.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Totals in the valid items reach one hundred pesos appropriately, but one option list offers 110 and 120 against a target of exactly one hundred, and the mismatched number-line items present amounts in the seventies and eighties that no part of their stem can produce.
